Corollary
[Classical-type Harnack inequality for evolving metrics] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0340, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0341 ↗ thm:chow-iii-li-yau-evolving-metrics 1. ch25:25.12\group Integrated Harnack Inequalities

Assume $\widetilde C_0^{-1}\widetilde g\leq g( au )leq \widetilde C_0\widetilde g$. Under the hypotheses of Theorem 2, for $x_1,x_2\in \mathcal M$ and $0< au _1< au _2\leq T$, \[ rac{u(x_2, au _2)}{u(x_1, au _1)} \geq e^{-C_{11}( au _2- au _1)} \left( rac{ au _2}{ au _1} ight)^{-n/(2-3\varepsilon )} \exp \left(- rac{\widetilde C_0d_{\widetilde g}(x_1,x_2)^2}{4(1-\varepsilon )( au _2- au _1)} ight), \] where $C_{11}=C_7+\sup _{\mathcal M imes [ au _1, au _2]}Q$.
Proof

\sketch Let $\gamma $ join $x_1$ to $x_2$. Along it, the global differential estimate and

\[ (1-\varepsilon )| abla \log u|^2 +\langle abla \log u,\dot\gamma angle \geq - rac{|\dot\gamma |^2}{4(1-\varepsilon )} \]

give

\[ \log rac{u(x_2, au _2)}{u(x_1, au _1)} \geq - rac1{4(1-\varepsilon )}\int _{ au _1}^{ au _2}|\dot\gamma |_{g( au )}^2d au - rac n{2-3\varepsilon }\log rac{ au _2}{ au _1} -C_{11}( au _2- au _1). \]

Take $\gamma $ to be a constant-speed minimizing $\widetilde g$-geodesic. Metric comparison bounds its energy by $\widetilde C_0d_{\widetilde g}(x_1,x_2)^2/( au _2- au _1)$. Exponentiation proves the claim.
